256.question: Political ideology is defined primarily as...

options.A: A technical procedure for counting electoral preferences
options.B: Any scientific description without evaluative guidelines
options.C: Any emotional reaction to a political event
options.D: The totality of only the legal norms currently in force
options.E: A doctrine that justifies a group's claims to power and its political goals

257.question: Which functions does political ideology perform?

options.A: Establishing legally binding sanctions by the force of the doctrine itself
options.B: It sets criteria for assessing political reality
options.C: It justifies claims to power
options.D: It integrates supporters around goals
options.E: Uniting supporters by eliminating the differences among all social interests

258.question: The elaboration of basic political values and ideals belongs to the ... level of ideology.

options.A: Administrative-legal
options.B: Theoretical-conceptual
options.C: Programmatic-political
options.D: Actualized
options.E: Behavioral-ritual

259.question: General ideals are translated into election demands and a program of action. Which level of ideology is represented?

options.A: Theoretical-conceptual
options.B: Actualized
options.C: Programmatic-political
options.D: Unconscious-affective
options.E: Institutional-judicial

260.question: Citizens are guided by ideological principles in specific political actions. This is the ... level.

options.A: Theoretical-conceptual
options.B: Doctrinal-abstract
options.C: Programmatic-political
options.D: Actualized
options.E: Legal-normative

261.question: The correct correspondence between a level of ideology and its content:

options.A: Programmatic-political: exclusively unconscious reactions
options.B: Theoretical-conceptual: the carrying out of a specific instruction
options.C: Actualized: the degree to which principles are put into practice
options.D: Actualized: the creation of an abstract philosophical system
options.E: Theoretical-conceptual: only voting results

262.question: The basic principles of classical liberalism include:

options.A: Religious toleration
options.B: Individual freedom
options.C: An estate hierarchy of rights
options.D: Constitutionalism
options.E: The priority of a single mandatory doctrine

263.question: Socially oriented versions of liberalism are distinguished from its early model by...

options.A: Allowing state measures for the sake of real opportunities for freedom
options.B: A complete rejection of constitutional limits on power
options.C: Recognition of a single mandatory religion
options.D: Replacing private initiative with mandatory estate membership
options.E: Giving up individual rights as a value in themselves

264.question: The most characteristic feature of conservatism is...

options.A: The dissolution of all institutions into the current will of the majority
options.B: A mandatory rejection of any historical continuity
options.C: The importance of tradition and caution in political transformation
options.D: The elimination of the distinction between society and a utopian project
options.E: Recognition of revolutionary rupture as a universal method

265.question: Defending the market does not in itself make it possible to classify a program unambiguously as liberal alone because...

options.A: Market attitudes can be combined with conservative values
options.B: Liberalism is not connected with economic freedom
options.C: Conservatism always demands the abolition of private property
options.D: The market is a feature of totalitarian doctrines only
options.E: All market programs exclude state institutions

266.question: Modern social-democratic ideology links social justice primarily with...

options.A: The need for permanent armed revolution
options.B: An unconditional ban on political pluralism
options.C: Democratic reforms and social peace
options.D: Giving up the defense of labor and social rights
options.E: A hereditary organization of state power

267.question: The fundamental difference between social democracy and revolutionary Marxism-Leninism is...

options.A: A preference for democratic reform over the revolutionary seizure of power
options.B: Recognition of the hereditary estate-based state by both doctrines
options.C: The absence of a political program in social democracy
options.D: A mandatory rejection of elections by both doctrines
options.E: Social democracy's complete renunciation of social justice

268.question: The utopian socialists of the late 18th and early 19th centuries include:

options.A: Edmund Burke
options.B: Jeremy Bentham
options.C: Charles Fourier
options.D: Henri de Saint-Simon
options.E: Robert Owen

269.question: National ideology links political claims primarily with...

options.A: Only the neutral procedure of judicial review
options.B: Exclusively professional qualifications
options.C: A single method of drawing up the state budget
options.D: Only individual consumer preferences
options.E: National affiliation and collective status

270.question: A movement defends the cultural identity of a diaspora without demanding the abolition of the state of residence. The well-founded conclusion is that...

options.A: National demands do not necessarily amount to the creation of a separate state
options.B: National affiliation cannot influence political status
options.C: Any national ideology automatically demands annexation
options.D: Defending identity is the same as giving up civil rights
options.E: Cultural demands exclude political content

271.question: Indicate the possible consequences of national ideologies, depending on the conditions.

options.A: Reducing group demands to a neutral description of economic indicators
options.B: The integration of the political community
options.C: The intensification of intergroup contradictions
options.D: The same effect on all national communities regardless of conditions
options.E: Replacing legal citizenship with the criterion of participation in international trade

272.question: The influence of ideologies increases especially in situations of...

options.A: Choosing directions of development and social modernization
options.B: The cessation of all public communication
options.C: The final disappearance of political interests
options.D: The complete absence of alternatives for the social order
options.E: Replacing all decisions with purely technical calculations

273.question: A party publishes a program, but its supporters do not apply the declared principles in their behavior. Which distinction has become apparent?

options.A: A gap between the programmatic-political and actualized levels
options.B: The identity of political ideology and a legal norm
options.C: The coincidence of a theoretical doctrine and its practical implementation
options.D: The absence of any ideological content in the program
options.E: The impossibility of the existence of ideological supporters

274.question: Which statements about the functioning of ideology are correct?

options.A: Ideology connects assessments of reality with goals for action
options.B: Having a program does not guarantee that its principles are embodied in actions
options.C: Setting out an ideal in a program is evidence of its practical assimilation by supporters
options.D: A political assessment acquires scientific proof by virtue of its ideological consistency
options.E: One doctrine can be assimilated in different ways by different groups

275.question: Which set of correspondences between ideologies and their emphases is correct?

options.A: Liberalism: an inalienable general will; conservatism: direct popular legislation; social democracy: hereditary representation
options.B: Liberalism: individual rights; conservatism: continuity; social democracy: social reforms
options.C: Liberalism: state paternalism; conservatism: value neutrality; social democracy: priority of a property qualification
options.D: Liberalism: mandatory equality of outcomes; conservatism: rejection of continuity; social democracy: estate solidarity
options.E: Liberalism: social wholeness; conservatism: rational reconstruction; social democracy: the minimal state
